pretreatment: pretreated in a fixed-bed flow-type ALD reactor in air at 773 K for 11–16 h and in nitrogen at 373 K for 2.5 h
evidence: The starting support was a silica (EP10, Crosfield Ltd., primary particle size /C24 110 mm, Na2O < 500 ppm) with a BET surface area, pore volume and average pore diameter of 301 m 2 g/C0 1, 1.2 cm 3 g/C0 1 and 19–20 nm, respectively. Chemically active surfaces were developed on silica pretreated at 873 K by gradually increasing titania amounts from submonolayer to above monolayer levels, i.e. from 3 to 7 Ti atoms per nm 2 of support (atom nm sup/C0 2).
